findings.message: The new cancel_event annotation references Any, but this module imports only List, Optional and Callable from typing. On Python 3.10/3.11 the annotation is evaluated at import time, so importing services.cleaner_service raises NameError; on Python 3.14 inspect.signature(CleanerService.scan) still raises NameError. Add Any to the typing import, or annotate the parameter with a built-in type.

Rendered duplicate checkboxes are the source of truth, but toggling one never updates _unrendered_dup_vars. _set_as_original destroys and re-populates the card, and this line rebuilds every checkbox from _unrendered_dup_vars, so a duplicate the user deliberately unchecked becomes selected again. A later Delete or Isolate can then remove files the user excluded. Preserve the existing checkbox value

The compare banner declares a 100% byte-for-byte match whenever os.path.getsize returns equal sizes. Size equality alone cannot prove identical content, so a same-size pair that changed after the duplicate scan is falsely certified as safe to delete. Compare the contents with filecmp.cmp(..., shallow=False) before setting the banner.
findings.patch_old:
identical = False
        try:
            sz1 = os.path.getsize(self.compare_filepath)
            sz2 = os.path.getsize(self.filepath)
            identical = (sz1 == sz2)
        except Exception:  # hygiene: allow file stat failure defaults identical flag to False
            pass
findings.patch_new:
identical = False
        try:
            import filecmp
            identical = filecmp.cmp(self.compare_filepath, self.filepath, shallow=False)
        except Exception:  # hygiene: allow comparison failure defaults identical flag to False
            pass

findings.message: The incremental WAL records a move only after shutil.move has completed, so a power loss between the move and the next _save_history leaves the file at its destination with no journal entry and undo cannot restore it. Persist the batch and an intent/pending move before executing it, then mark the move done after, so the power-loss promise is actually covered; the new test only flips a status after
